tools.name: get_project_context
tools.description: Where the current project stands: name, current phase, each phase's status, links (Figma files, repo, docs, design system, deliverables), the latest handoff, recent decisions and context, and the suggested next step. Call before phase work.

path.description: A folder inside the project — pass the current working directory when unsure. Optional; defaults to the server's working directory.

tools.name: get_memories
tools.description: Read the project's memories, newest first, optionally filtered by type and phase.

path.description: A folder inside the project — pass the current working directory when unsure. Optional; defaults to the server's working directory.

phase.description: 01 discover · 02 define · 03 ideate · 04 prototype · 05 validate · 06 build & deliver

tools.name: write_memory
tools.description: Save something to the project as it happens: a decision, deliverable summary (context), phase handoff, engagement brief, friction pattern, preference, gap (Pathlon had no skill for the job, or the designer corrected its approach), or session summary. A handoff needs the phase it closes and also updates the readable handoff file.

path.description: A folder inside the project — pass the current working directory when unsure. Optional; defaults to the server's working directory.

phase.description: 01 discover · 02 define · 03 ideate · 04 prototype · 05 validate · 06 build & deliver. Defaults to the current phase; required for handoff.

summary.description: One line (default: the content's first line).

agent.description: Which agent is writing, e.g. researcher.

tools.name: recommend_starting_point
tools.description: What to do next in the project and why, with the latest handoff and open decisions for context.

path.description: A folder inside the project — pass the current working directory when unsure. Optional; defaults to the server's working directory.

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Start a Pathlon project. With path, the project lives in that folder (in .pathlon/); without path, in ~/.pathlon/projects/<name>/ for work that has no folder. share_in_git=false keeps the project's state out of git (client work).

path.description: Folder the project belongs to (usually the current working directory).

phase.description: Starting phase (default 01). 01 discover · 02 define · 03 ideate · 04 prototype · 05 validate · 06 build & deliver

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: All Pathlon projects on this machine, newest first, with where each lives.

tools.name: link_artifact
tools.description: Record something the project uses or produced: a Figma file, repo, doc, the design system's source, or a deliverable (artifact). Linking the same kind and URL again updates it.

path.description: A folder inside the project — pass the current working directory when unsure. Optional; defaults to the server's working directory.

phase.description: 01 discover · 02 define · 03 ideate · 04 prototype · 05 validate · 06 build & deliver

source.description: Deliverables: a framework deliverable or one the team defined.

tools.name: set_phase
tools.description: Start, complete, or reset a phase. Starting a phase makes it the current phase. Use when a phase closes (after its handoff) or a new one begins.

path.description: A folder inside the project — pass the current working directory when unsure. Optional; defaults to the server's working directory.

phase.description: 01 discover · 02 define · 03 ideate · 04 prototype · 05 validate · 06 build & deliver

tools.name: detect_patterns
tools.description: Warning signs in the project: a phase stalled with no recent activity, phases skipped, or a completed phase with no handoff.

path.description: A folder inside the project — pass the current working directory when unsure. Optional; defaults to the server's working directory.

tools.name: log_figma_activity
tools.description: After Figma MCP writes, record what was created so the project keeps track of Figma work. Links the Figma file and saves a context memory.

path.description: A folder inside the project — pass the current working directory when unsure. Optional; defaults to the server's working directory.

action.description: What was created or changed, in a sentence.

phase.description: 01 discover · 02 define · 03 ideate · 04 prototype · 05 validate · 06 build & deliver

artifact_type.description: e.g. research board, wireframes, component set.

tools.name: usage_report
tools.description: How Pathlon is performing, across all projects on this machine (or one project): which skills, agents and commands get used, each agent's first-try Definition of Done pass rate, skills never used, gap notes, and what to refine or add. Use when asked how Pathlon is doing, what to improve, or what's missing.

path.description: A folder inside the project — pass the current working directory when unsure. Optional; defaults to the server's working directory.

scope.description: all (default): every registered project. project: only the project found from path or project_id.

since.description: Only records on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).
